errors.text_span: The tallest bar is located in the 10-15 interval at approximately 0.41, followed closely by the 15-20 interval bar at nearly the same height.
errors.evidence: This phrasing implies that the bar for the 10-15 interval is uniquely the tallest and the bar for the 15-20 interval is shorter. Visually, both bars appear to be the same height (approximately 0.41), and they are jointly the tallest bars in the chart.
The top of the bar for the 30-35 interval is visibly below the 0.35 tick mark. Its value is closer to 0.34.
